theme: A quiet evening before a busy 48 hours.
greeting: The girls are home and today stayed open, Dan. The next two days do the heavy lifting: tomorrow's move to House 2 and the Brunswick call, with Croatia's Sept 8 booking wall closing in behind them.

needsAttention.title: Build the larder bin before tomorrow's move
needsAttention.detail: House 1 checks out and the St. Pete Ranch stay begins tomorrow (Sept 3). The travel larder bin was meant to be packed before this first changeover so the migration is the test run while there's still time to fix it.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Croatia bookings before you fly
needsAttention.detail: The single Cavtat night on Sept 19, the Sept 20-22 St. Pete landing gap, and confirming checked bags are actually on the ticket all have to be done from dry land before the Sept 8 departure. All three are past due in Todoist.

needsAttention.title: Tighten your board narrative for Brunswick
needsAttention.detail: Lauren Nadig's connect call is tomorrow at 3:30 PM ET and you've already accepted. Arrive with your board-search story sharp and a read on where Brunswick's corporate-affairs work meets governance.
